name: Cleghorn Minerals Ltd.
summary: Cleghorn Minerals Ltd. focuses on the discovery, evaluation, and promotion of various mineral properties and other ventures. The company actively explores for iron, titanium, vanadium, gold, silver, copper, zinc, and a wide array of other minerals or elements. A primary asset is its complete ownership of the Meech Lake Matachewan prospect, which encompasses 183 claims covering an area of 3,892.3 hectares. This prospect is located within the Argyle, Baden, McNeil, and Robertson Townships in Northeastern Ontario. Established in 2010, the firm's main office is situated in Val-d'Or, Canada.
